snippet.title: KOF XV DLC｜SHINGO YABUKI｜Trailer
snippet.description:
THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV Season 2 starts Jan 17th, 2023!
SHINGO YABUKI, the first Season 2 DLC character to launch, will release along-side a massive character refinement patch.  In addition to KIM, SYLVIE PAULA PAULA and NAJD were also announced to join as Season 2 DLC characters!

『THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV』2023年1月17日よりシーズン2が開幕！
シーズン2 DLCキャラクター第1弾「矢吹真吾」の配信とゲームバランス調整を実施。
さらに新たなDLCキャラクター「キム」、「シルヴィ」、「ナジュド」の参戦も決定！
